title: Prefix stability
statement: A function $r$ from finite Boolean strings to optional values is prefix stable if, whenever it returns a value $a$ on a string $w$, it returns that same value on every extension formed by appending another finite Boolean string $v$ to $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ maps finite Boolean strings to optional values
